method: grep of process.env.X, process.env[expr], env.X on ProcessEnv parameters, helper string literals (setting(), getDefaultUrl/redirectUrl fallback names, enabledEnv), NATIVE_INDEX_ENV_KEYS forwarding; process reachability from a static+dynamic import graph rooted at server/index.ts (api), bot/index.ts (bot), workers/cron.index.ts and each workers/*.worker.ts (cron:<name>). Reachability means the module is loaded in that process, not that every line executes there.

dotenv.order: Non-production (NODE_ENV!=="production"): dotenv.config(.env.local) then dotenv.config(.env); dotenv never overrides already-set vars, so precedence = real environment > .env.local > .env. Production: only .env (but /app/.env does not exist in the image: .dockerignore excludes .env*, so variables come only from compose env_file + environment + image ENV).
dotenv.esm_hoisting_caveat: server/index.ts and bot/index.ts call dotenv AFTER their static imports are evaluated (ESM hoisting), so every module-level (import-time) env read in imported modules sees only the real process environment, never .env files. Only per-use reads see dotenv values. Workers using `import "dotenv/config"` as first import (goals, duel, widgets, credit_gifts, roulette-actions; follow_defense_actions uses dotenv.config() after one import) load .env before later imports.
dotenv.cwd: dotenv paths are resolved from process.cwd() (/app in containers).
